One identity.
A clear point of view.

GEM brings a precise, restrained approach to hospitality amenities and packaging. The ambition is simple: let each detail contribute to a coherent guest experience.

A partner to those
who shape hospitality.

Our focus is the people who run, develop and equip hospitality properties. Owners need consistency. Procurement teams need clear information. Operators need an approach they can understand and repeat. Brand and design teams need a shared language for every application.

Amenities & Packaging is GEM’s primary business stream. It carries the master identity across the portfolio rather than creating separate brands for every format or programme. Commercial capabilities and product readiness must be confirmed for the specific project.

Four principles.
One way of working.

Precision

Give each name, line and detail a clear purpose. State what is verified; make open questions visible.

Restraint

Keep what helps the guest or the people serving them. Let proportion and clarity do the work.

Geometry

Use a consistent visual language so different objects feel part of the same family.

Space

Make room for information to be read and objects to be understood.

Built around the people
behind the stay.
